evidence.quoted_text:
def atomic(filename, data):
    filename = Path(filename)
    durable_directory(filename.parent)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=filename.parent, delete=False) as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary = stream.name
    os.replace(temporary, filename)
    fsync_dir(filename.parent)
evidence.reason: `atomic()` creates the staging file with `delete=False` and only assigns `temporary` after `write`, `flush`, and `fsync` succeed. If any of those calls or `os.replace` raises, the staging file is left behind. This is an ordinary resource-leak defect in the existing atomic-write behavior, not a new requirement.
